note: Model weights live in config, not code, so the model can be tuned and audited without a rewrite (see BUILD_PLAN.md, research registry).

demand_trend_shift.note: A declining local demand trend pushes the timeline one band sooner; growing pulls it one band later. Affects timeline only, never the base exposure score.

union_protection.note: Collective-bargaining coverage slows involuntary displacement (labour-economics research). Shifts the timeline one band later; never changes the base exposure score.

seniority.note: Experience shifts a worker's task mix toward less-exposed judgment and oversight work. Linear up to the cap.

confidence.note: Half-width of the reported exposure range, in points. Set wide on purpose: the backtest (CALIBRATION.md) shows the model RANKS risk well (AUC ~0.69, top-risk decile lost jobs while the bottom grew) but predicts individual outcomes weakly (low R2), so honest results are ranges, not points.

green_match.note: The green-option match already prefers safer destinations because 'safer' now means a lower calibrated exposure (exposure_model), which rewards high-interpersonal, low-routine work. This block adds a small extra tilt so that, among similarly-reachable moves, the ones whose safety is DURABLE (human-centred) rank first - grounded in the two backtest-validated factors (interpersonal protects, routine_structured raises risk; see CALIBRATION.md), centred at 0.5 so an average role is neutral.

future_fit.note: Blend weights for the 'careers worth aiming for' ranking (future_careers). safe = 100 - calibrated exposure; pay and growth are normalised 0-100. Weights by priority; each list is then ordered by the dimension its label promises.

exposure_model.note: Headline automation-exposure score (0-100). Interpretable weighted average of four task-intrinsic sub-scores, all oriented so higher = more automatable. interpersonal enters as protection (100 - interpersonal). Weights for the two data-validated factors are derived from the cross-validated calibration (analysis/calibrate.py); ai/robo carry a research-set prior. The engine reads these weights; it never fits a model or calls an LLM to score.
